entries.en: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.

entries.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
entries.en: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him, as many times as His creation, as much as pleases Him, as weighty as His Throne, and as abundant as the ink of His words.

entries.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
entries.en: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
entries.titleEn: At the end of a gathering
